episode_summary: Andrew Hunter Murray hosts a Little Fish episode with Dan Schreiber and Anna Ptaszynski, sharing listener-submitted curios including John Cazale’s flawless Best Picture streak, contrasting speeding fines in Australia and India, Tudor naming trivia, and James Garfield’s proof of Pythagoras’ theorem. The trio also riff through many additional mini-facts and patron shout-outs.
